newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch consumer confidence turns sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Dutch consumer confidence turns sharply lower.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index for November took a sharp downturn after a steady rise over the previous six months, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Wednesday.

The CBS noted that the deterioration in the overall index to two in November from eight in October was largely due to a drop in the sub-index of consumers' feelings about the general economic situation. This fell to two from 14.
The other sub-index which makes up the overall index measures consumers' feelings about their personal financial situation and spending plans. This fell to two from five.
The CBS said November was the third successive month in which the personal finances sub-index had shown a decline.
The CBS's November survey showed that consumers felt the time was not right for major purchases, but the CBS said this was a normal seasonal phenomenon towards the end of the year.
